entities.name: PMID:10738567
observations: Naked intramuscular plasmid encoding furin and modified rat proinsulin increased circulating insulin/C-peptide and reduced hyperglycemia in STZ-diabetic mice; two injections improved results versus one.

entities.name: PMID:12378405
observations: Electrotransfer of furin-cleavable human proinsulin plasmid into skeletal muscle produced circulating insulin, lowered fasting glucose, and prolonged survival in STZ-diabetic mice.

entities.name: PMID:12594852
observations: Naked intramuscular CGRP plasmid with electroporation decreased diabetes morbidity and hyperglycemia in multiple-low-dose STZ autoimmune diabetic mice and protected islets.

entities.name: Plasmid muscle diabetes benefit
observations: Preclinical mouse studies show naked plasmid delivery to skeletal muscle can improve glycemia or reduce autoimmune diabetes occurrence; these findings do not establish human efficacy.
